raw.details:
All That You Need to Know About SPECTRONA Hackathon 2026

Overview

The SPECTRONA 2026 Hackathon is a problem-solving competition where participants work in teams to develop practical, technology-based solutions to real-world problem statements.

Date: 22–24 October 2026
Venue: National Forensic Sciences University, Guwahati
️ Organised by: NFSU Guwahati

Problem Statements Are Live

The official SPECTRONA 2026 Hackathon problem statements are now live.

Participants are requested to carefully go through the available problem statements and select a challenge that aligns with their team's skills, interests and technical capabilities.

View the Official Problem Statements:
SPECTRONA 2026 Problem Statements

Important: The problem statements are divided into two difficulty categories. Teams should review the requirements and difficulty level carefully before finalising their choice. Evaluation will take the respective difficulty category into consideration.

Who Can Participate?

  • Students from colleges and universities.

  • Inter-college and inter-disciplinary teams may participate.

  • Team size will be as per the final hackathon guidelines.

Hackathon Format

Participants will:

  1. Select a problem statement.

  2. Understand the problem and proposed requirements.

  3. Develop a technology-based solution or working prototype.

  4. Demonstrate their solution before the judging panel.

  5. Present their approach, implementation and impact.

Evaluation

Projects may be evaluated on:

  • Understanding of the problem

  • Innovation and originality

  • Technical implementation

  • Practical feasibility

  • Quality of the proposed solution

  • Prototype/demo

  • Presentation and explanation

General Rules

  • Participants must follow the official hackathon rules and code of conduct.

  • Submitted work must comply with the eligibility and submission guidelines.

  • Plagiarism or violation of the rules may result in disqualification.

  • Teams must submit their work in the format specified by the organising committee.

  • The decision of the judging panel and organising committee will be final.

Important Note

Participants are advised to read the complete problem statements and submission guidelines before beginning development. Further information regarding team formation, schedule, submission procedure and detailed judging criteria will be communicated by the organising team.

Start Building. Solve. Create. Demonstrate.

SPECTRONA 2026 Hackathon
NFSU Guwahati | 22–24 October 2026
